notes.title: The new Adventure starts NOW!
notes.content:
Hey future Beasties trainer!

Today is the day!
[b]Our first [b][url=https://bit.ly/3b9ooKS]Kickstarter[/url][/b] starts right NOW![/b]
[b]Support us on Kickstarter and be part of the development of Beasties from the very beginning![/b]

[previewyoutube=c3S9-u4dbu8;full][/previewyoutube]

[h3][b]About Beasties:[/b][/h3]
Beasties is a lovingly hand-drawn 2D top/down monster trainer game with a turn-based match-3 combat mechanic, where you take on the role of a Beastie trainer. Form alliances with Beasties, earn money with farming, explore the world, craft food for the Beasties and craft various items. Collect and manage resources, discover small and big secrets and solve countless side tasks and challenges in a peaceful (wholesome) and humorous world.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1592600/Beasties__an_adorable_Monster_Trainer_Match3__Farming_game/

[h3][b]Key Features:[/b][/h3]
[list]
[*] Sophisticated genre mix of Monster Trainer, Match-3 & Farming 
[*] Easy to learn, hard to master Turn-Based Match-3 Combat
[*]  Team up with Beasties, upgrade and customize them to your gameplay
[*] Earn money with farming
[*] Sell your goods or craft new ones on the market
[*]  Be a co-producer 🚀 and part of the development of this game
[*]  The game is 100% Plant-Based 🌾🌱 and we care about diversity 👧👳🏼‍♂️👴🏽👩🏾‍🦰
[*] The game will be released on PC (Steam, Gog etc) and on Nintendo Switch.
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33933433/60b799939ae8ec6c6d0da62762eb6109ffaac46f.jpg[/img]

[b][url=https://linktr.ee/rokaplay]Follow us on your prefered Social Media platform![/url][/b]

❤Your team at rokaplay❤

notes.title: New Adventure ahead!
notes.content:
[previewyoutube=H_pcu2vQNHc;full][/previewyoutube]

Hey Adventurer,

We at rokaplay have committed ourselves to the [url=https://www.rokaplay.com/mission-statement][b]mission[/b][/url] to develop wholesome games and therefore it's time to pack your backpack and set off on a new adventure!

🎉We present a heart project directly from the deep mines of the rokaplay team coming to Kickstarter!🎉

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33933433/60b799939ae8ec6c6d0da62762eb6109ffaac46f.jpg[/img]

[b][h3]About Beasties - A community driven Monster trainer game[/h3][/b]
Beasties is a lovingly hand-drawn 2D top/down monster trainer game with a turn-based match-3 combat mechanic, where you take on the role of a Beastie trainer. Form alliances with Beasties, earn money with farming, explore the world, craft food for the Beasties and craft various items. Collect and manage resources, discover small and big secrets and solve countless side tasks and challenges in a peaceful (wholesome) and humorous world.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1592600/Beasties__an_adorable_Monster_Trainer_Match3__Farming_game/

[url=https://bit.ly/3b9ooKS][b]Kickstarter[/b][/url] will start rolling on May the 18th and you are invited to join this special event, follow us into this new adventure!
For us, there could be no better travel companions than you!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33933433/4fdf0983f0ad6b6445c27c0508dab68090444ec0.jpg[/img]
Here our first [url=https://imgur.com/gallery/DcHLpOh][b]Imgur post[/b][/url] for our upcoming game Beasties: "Behind the Scene: We spent 4 month to develope our own World-Editor, here is why!" 

Besides Super Dungeon Maker, Beasties is the second game we have announced this year. If you love wholesome games as much as we do, follow us on [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1592600/Beasties__an_adorable_Monster_Trainer_Match3__Farming_game/][b]Steam[/b][/url]  or on [url=https://discord.gg/rokaplay][b]Discord[/b][/url] to never miss another adventure with us.

[url=https://linktr.ee/rokaplay][b]Follow us on Social Media[/b][/url]
Cheers and stay safe! 
Your team at rokaplay

notes.title: New Game: The Forgotten Land
notes.content:
Hi everyone,

After the relaxing fun in our 5 Star Resort series and the insane sugar fights with rabid ex tofu lovers on the Last Resort Island, our new game takes you to the Forgotten Land - a legendary place ruled by dark forces.

Experience a dark adventure in a unique puzzle genre mix full of challenges, dangers and turn-based Match 3 battles. If you're ready to break the evil forces' dark spell, visit our Steam page.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1099460/The_Forgotten_Land/

PLEASE DON'T FORGET:

(1) ADD OUR GAME ON YOUR WISHLIST AND/OR FOLLOW US ːsteamhappyː

notes.title: 5 Star Miami Resort: Now available!
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34578730/fa8a6499290dfd3e9cfba7f522c4d1a59f42982a.png[/img]
Hi to all prospective hotel managers and passionate Match 3 fans,

Have you ever dreamt of building your own dream vacation or even dream resort? Our new game [i]5 Star Miami Resort[/i] will be released today and lets you just do that! Enjoy colorful visuals and strategic puzzle gameplay. 

It's quite an ambitious project! Put your talents as a hotel manager to the test: Construct 25 clever hotel buildings and additions. Play on linked boards that extend over several screens. Master creative challenges and unlock creative achievements. Don't forget it’s all about the right strategy!

Play [i]5 Star Miami Resort[/i] today! 

https://store.steampowered.com/app/952230/5_Star_Miami_Resort/

Are you interested in beta testing our games? Please feel free to put your name on our [url=https://rokapublish.us15.list-manage.com/subscribe/post?u=4f725dfd794f834c7ce3d26f7&id=00ab2a3bec]Mailing List[/url].

notes.title: Are you the next hotel tycoon in Miami?
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33025590/52fe05db660fd96641289cd7ba341e91553cb16c.png[/img]

Hi to all prospective top hotel managers and passionate Match 3 fans,

Have you ever dreamt of building your own ground-breaking resort? Well, from the 25th of June your dreams may come true. We have a very ambitious project for you: Build a mega hotel resort like no other! Are you up to the task? In an exciting Match 3 resort construction in Miami City you'll have to master linked boards, discover hidden obstacles and choose from various buildings which impact your gameplay experience. Are you going to find the right strategy to turn your Miami Resort into yet another success story?

[b][i]5 Star Miami Resort [/i][/b]will be released on Steam on [b]June 25, 2019[/b]! Make sure you [b]wishlist the game now[/b], so you won't miss its release: [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/799080]More information[/url] and wishlist now!
